CREATE PROC BNKM.SP_CurrencyConversion_FillGapDates
AS
BEGIN

IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM sys.tables WHERE [name] like '%CurrencyConversion_FillGapDates%') 
BEGIN
   DROP TABLE bnkm.CurrencyConversion_FillGapDates;
END;


with CurrencyConversion
AS(
    SELECT * FROM BNKM.CurrencyConversion WHERE ConvertToCurrencyId = 'PHP' AND RateId = 'REV' )


,GetMinMaxDate AS (
SELECT 
	ConvertFromCurrencyId,
	ConvertToCurrencyId,
	ExchangeRateTypeId,
    RateId, 
    FinancialInstitutionId,
    SourceCode,
    convert(DATE, MIN(CurrencyConversionTimestamp)) AS min_date,
    CONVERT(DATE, MAX(CurrencyConversionTimestamp)) AS max_date 
  FROM 
    CurrencyConversion
    GROUP BY ConvertFromCurrencyId, ConvertToCurrencyId, ExchangeRateTypeId, RateId,  FinancialInstitutionId, SourceCode
)
,FullDate AS (
SELECT 
	b.ConvertFromCurrencyId,
	b.ConvertToCurrencyId,
	b.ExchangeRateTypeId,
    b.RateId, 
    b.FinancialInstitutionId,
    b.SourceCode,
	CONVERT(VARCHAR,a.FullDate,112) AS FullDate2,
    a.FullDate, 
    b.min_date, 
    b.max_date 
  FROM 
    dw.dimdate a 
    LEFT JOIN GetMinMaxDate b
	ON a.FullDate >= b.min_date 
    AND a.FullDate <= b.max_date 
  WHERE b.ConvertFromCurrencyId IS NOT NULL
)

,Distinct_Curr AS (
SELECT DISTINCT 
 ConvertFromCurrencyId ,ConvertToCurrencyId ,ExchangeRateTypeId ,ConversionRate ,CurrencyConversionTimestamp ,RateId ,FinancialInstitutionId,SourceCode ,WorkFlowId ,TaskRunId ,InsertDttm 
FROM CurrencyConversion b
)

, join_balance as (
select 
 ISNULL(b.ConvertFromCurrencyId,a.ConvertFromCurrencyId) AS ConvertFromCurrencyId
,ISNULL(b.ConvertToCurrencyId, a.ConvertToCurrencyId) AS ConvertToCurrencyId
,ISNULL(b.ExchangeRateTypeId,a.ExchangeRateTypeId) AS ExchangeRateTypeId
,b.ConversionRate AS ConversionRate
,ISNULL(b.CurrencyConversionTimestamp,a.FullDate) AS CurrencyConversionTimestamp
,FullDate2
,ISNULL(b.RateId,a.RateId) AS RateId
,ISNULL(b.FinancialInstitutionId,a.FinancialInstitutionId) AS FinancialInstitutionId
,ISNULL(b.SourceCode,a.SourceCode) AS SourceCode
,ISNULL(b.WorkFlowId,0) AS WorkFlowId
,ISNULL(b.TaskRunId,0) AS TaskRunId
,ISNULL(b.InsertDttm,getdate()) AS InsertDttm                           
FROM FullDate a
LEFT JOIN Distinct_Curr b
    ON b.ConvertFromCurrencyId = a.ConvertFromCurrencyId
    AND b.ConvertToCurrencyId = a.ConvertToCurrencyId
    AND b.ExchangeRateTypeId = a.ExchangeRateTypeId
    AND b.RateId = a.RateId
    AND a.FullDate = b.CurrencyConversionTimestamp
    AND b.FinancialInstitutionId = a.FinancialInstitutionId
    AND b.SourceCode = a.SourceCode
)
, get_row as (
select *,ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ConvertFromCurrencyId,FinancialInstitutionId ORDER BY CurrencyConversionTimestamp ) AS Row# 
, case when [ConversionRate] is null then 0 else 1 end as ChangeIndicator
from join_balance
)

,rowgrp as (
select *, Sum(ChangeIndicator) over (PARTITION BY ConvertFromCurrencyId,FinancialInstitutionId ORDER BY Row#) RowGroup from get_row
)


,final_curr as (
select 
ConvertFromCurrencyId
,ConvertToCurrencyId
,CurrencyConversionTimestamp
,RateId
,case when [ConversionRate] is not null then ConversionRate else first_value(ConversionRate) over (partition by RowGroup,ConvertFromCurrencyId, ConvertToCurrencyId,FinancialInstitutionId ORDER BY Row#) end ConversionRate
,FinancialInstitutionId
,SourceCode
,WorkFlowId
,TaskRunId
,InsertDttm                           
from rowgrp ) 

select * 
into BNKM.CurrencyConversion_FillGapDates from final_curr ;

END
GO
